name: Week Number Calculator
summary: Get the ISO 8601 or US week number for any date — plus weekday, week year, and date range.
description: Pick a date to see its week number under ISO 8601 (Monday start) or US weeks (Sunday start). Shows week year, weekday name, ISO label, and the week’s start/end dates. Also look up a week year + week number to get the date range. Runs locally.

faqs.question: What is ISO 8601 week numbering?
faqs.answer: Weeks start on Monday. Week 1 is the week containing the year’s first Thursday. Near New Year the week year can differ from the calendar year.

faqs.question: How do US weeks work?
faqs.answer: Weeks start on Sunday. Week 1 is the week that contains January 1.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Calculation runs entirely in your browser.
